title: Define session rule, scoped preference, and batch session management boundaries
description: Rust currently has provider preference and session status ports, but AstrBot's session management routes support scoped session rules, provider preferences by capability, KB/plugin/service config, group management, and batch updates by unified message origin. Define a session rule boundary before dashboard session management or per-session feature toggles expand storage, pipeline, and web handlers independently.

files.change: Represent per-UMO service, plugin, KB, and provider capability preferences outside pipeline context.
Model dashboard-managed session groups and batch targets separately from conversation history.
Persist scoped rules and batch snapshots without overloading ProviderPreferenceRepository.
Keep HTTP batch update/list handlers delegating to typed session services.

criteria: ProviderPreferenceRepository remains focused or is replaced by a typed scoped-preference service.
Session service/plugin/KB/provider rules can be tested without web routes.
Batch session update logic does not live in pipeline stages or runtime policy DTOs.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-storage && cargo test -p astrbot-pipeline && cargo test -p astrbot-web && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
